title: scenario-labs/skills: agent skills that price an image before they spend
friendlyTitle: scenario-labs/skills: agent skills that show the price before they make an image
summary: scenario-labs/skills was the highest unpublished AI repository on GitHub's daily trending page, with 674 stars in that window and 2,954 in total. It is MIT-licensed. The repository description says the skills get production-ready images, video, audio, and 3D from an agent by picking a model, pricing the job before spending, and keeping characters and brands consistent through the Scenario MCP. It also includes expert skills for Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal, and Unity. A commit landed on 5 November.
friendlySummary: scenario-labs/skills was the highest unpublished AI repository on GitHub's daily trending page, with 674 stars in that window and 2,954 in total. The license is MIT. The repository says the skills get finished images, video, audio, and 3D from an agent. They pick a model, price the job before spending, and try to keep a character or brand consistent, through Scenario's MCP connection. It also includes expert skills for Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal, and Unity. A commit landed on 5 November.
whyItMatters: Use it when an agent is about to generate media and you want a skill that chooses a model and shows a price before the call, instead of spending first. The media path goes through Scenario's MCP, so a local checkout is not a free image generator. Read which skill needs an account before you point an agent at it.
